server_id.description: CSPRNG-generated, lowercase unsigned hex, exactly 16 characters. Deliberately not vanilla's joinServer format (§5.1).

attempt_id.description: Separate CSPRNG value, >= 128 bits, base64url or hex. A bearer secret — MUST NOT appear in a URL, MUST NOT be logged (§5.1).

expires_in.description: Seconds until the challenge expires. RECOMMENDED 30, MUST NOT exceed 120 (§5.1).
